decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1 The  proposed removal of condition 6, in allowing a non corporate advertisement sign  would , by reason of   its  position  in relation to a nearby elevated section of the M4 motorway, allow a continual change of advertisements and be a potential road safety hazard and endanger the free flow of traffic and is contrary to the Policies  ENVB 1.1, (New Development), ENVB 1.4 (Advertisements)  and T4.4 (Road Safety)  of the  Unitary Development Plan(2003).
2  The proposed non corporate advertisement sign would, by reason of its potential size, position and appearance ,  represent  an intrusive  feature  to the detriment of the visual amenity of the local area.    The proposal is contrary to the policies IMP4.2, (the Great West Road), ENVB 1.1 (New development) and ENVB 1.4 (Advertisements) of the  Unitary Development Plan(2003).
